newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler debt deal stirs up quiet corp bond market.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler debt deal stirs up quiet corp bond market.

text.p: Chrysler Corp is expected to stir up some activity in the corporate bond new issue market with a $500 million century bond offering via Salomon Brothers, high-grade syndicate sources said.
The 100-year issue is expected to price at a spread of 81 basis points over U.S. Treasuries, syndicate sources said.
Dealers said the issue has already been well received by the market and is issue-bid going into the pricing which is expected later today.
"The Chrysler deal is in very good shape," said one syndicate source.
Overall players said the market had a positive tone to it as U.S. Treasury yields remain at attractive levels inducing U.S. corporations to tap the market at cheaper financing levels.
However, players expressed some concerns over recent developments in the market as President Clinton's budget proposals hit home.
"With congress talking about possibly knocking out the 100-year bond, although just a proposal at this point, this will have an effect on the market," one syndicate source said.
